embeddingSpace.reduction: leading-dimension truncation followed by L2 renormalization (MOD-04)

conversion.kind: third-party ONNX conversion of the source checkpoint
conversion.note: MOD-01 requires the artifact lock to name the exact conversion, quantization and preprocessing. None has been measured on this host, so none is written here: a guessed profile would be indistinguishable from a measured one, and a later reader would trust it.

engine.kind: onnxruntime-node (native CPU execution provider) driven by @huggingface/transformers
engine.note: Both packages are declared as optional dependencies. The versions that actually execute are recorded when the route is qualified (MOD-19), not assumed from a semver range.

tokenizer.identity: ships with the conversion; not yet inspected
tokenizer.note: The tokenizer identity is part of the embedding-space descriptor (MOD-03). It is deliberately not guessed from the base model name: the conversion may carry a different vocabulary file.

processor.note: MOD-06 requires the exact task prefix and processor template per purpose and role, with golden processor fixtures. No fixture exists yet, so no recipe is pinned. A text-only recipe is the first one to qualify.

groups.note: The text backbone, its tokenizer and its config. MOD-02 requires a text-only call to prepare and load this group WITHOUT fetching the vision or audio weights, so the group is declared separately even though its file list is not yet recorded.
The vision encoder and the image preprocessor configuration. Not prepared by default: MOD-02 states that a default installation does not imply every group is prepared.

The audio encoder and the feature-extractor configuration. MOD-01 records that the conversion's load_audio/load_video convenience helpers rely on browser APIs, so a bounded Node decoder is part of this group's work, not an optional extra.

pinning.reason: No artifact has been downloaded, hashed or run on this host. The lock records the identities that are known from the review directive and the repository specification, and refuses to invent the rest: a SHA-256 that was never computed is worse than an absent one, because it reads as verification.
requiredBeforeQualification: the exact revision (commit) of google/embeddinggemma-2 the conversion was made from
the exact revision of onnx-community/embeddinggemma-2-ONNX that is prepared
the file names and quantization profile of every prepared artifact
the SHA-256 of every prepared file, as the host's acquisition step verifies it before use
the tokenizer and processor identities that ship with that revision

embeddinggemma-2-onnx.platformNote: MOD-19's target is plain built JavaScript on Windows x64 CPU. Other platforms are declared in the manifest only once a run exists there, because a platform table is not proof of correct inference (MODEL-05).

network.when: once, during asset preparation by the host, before any inference
network.note: The extension itself performs no network call: the host acquires and verifies the pinned bytes and hands the extension local paths (PreparedAssetMapV1). The manifest therefore declares network.otherNetworkUse true while permissions.networkOrigins stays empty.

license.name: Apache License 2.0
license.note: Apache-2.0 is a redistribution-permitting, OSI-approved licence, which is why this package's weights layer differs from the Desert Ant packages' source-available weights. The declaration records what the model card states; it was not re-verified against the card on this host.

embeddinggemma-2-onnx.note: The empty assets array does NOT mean preparation fetches nothing (unlike the Tongue package, which bundles its weights). It means the exact file list and digests are not yet measured. The three groups above are the loading boundaries MOD-02 requires; filling their asset lists is the first task of the inference slice.
